meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接、脚本或简介变成可发布的产品发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把产品或活动快速做成一支能直接发布的宣传短片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link, script, or brief into a publishable product launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a ready-to-publish promo clip for a product or launch

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接手做产品发布或推广视频：抓取产品网址或读取你粘贴的脚本，选定设计预设，写出分镜与脚本，逐帧生成画面，最后渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当你想发布、推广或揭晓一个产品时触发；商业网址默认走这条路径，网站导览与展示也归到这里。

say.text: 用 acme.com 做一个产品发布视频。
say.note: 会抓取该网址并初始化项目

say.text: 这是新功能的推广脚本，我贴给你。
say.note: 脚本存下来后进入分镜与配音

say.text: 做一段网站导览视频，按原样展示页面。
say.note: 以已捕获的截图为视觉依据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds a product launch or promo video: it captures your product URL or reads a pasted script, picks a design preset, writes the storyboard and script, builds frames one by one, then renders the MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to launch, promote, or reveal a product; commercial URLs default here, and site tours or showcases route here too.

say_en.text: Make a product launch video for acme.com.
say_en.note: Captures the URL and starts the project

say_en.text: Here's my script — make a promo for our new feature.
say_en.note: Saves the script, then drafts the storyboard

say_en.text: Make a site tour video that shows the page as it is.
say_en.note: Uses captured screenshots as the visual source
